blocks.x: Is there anything else? Now I’m all, I’m all questioned out. [laughing]
No. No, it was good. Those are–
No, those were good. Those are wonderful. As, as am I.

Is there anything else that you want to add, Yusef? Can you think of someone getting this, you know, 50, 100 years from now, they’re going to say, “Hmm, let me hear what Yusef Lateef has to say about music, about [indecipherable]?”
